name: oldhand
description: A pack of 11 Agent Skills that take a ticket, doc or prompt to a verified change: a conductor plus contract, trace, rca, research, plan, build, review, qa, ship and learn. Small scripts compute the verdict, not the model.

interface.longDescription: Eleven skills, one job each: write the contract, trace the real path, find the root cause, check prior art, plan the smallest change, build it, review it with a panel, test it in the real app, and ship only what the ledger verifies. The learn stage writes down what the next session should know.
defaultPrompt: Use Oldhand on this ticket. Write the contract, trace the real path, plan, build, review and QA it end to end, then ship only if the ledger says VERIFIED.
Use Oldhand to find the root cause of this bug. Run contract, trace and rca first, fix the class of bug, and replay the original failing case.
Use Oldhand in plan-only mode. Run contract, trace, research and plan, then stop and wait for my approval before any edit.
